name: Drums
description: Tempo-synced multi-genre drum kit. Hold to gate — hits lock to the host beat. GENRE selects the pattern; KIT picks the synthetic voice feel (AUTO follows GENRE). X densifies ghosts/hats/stutters; Y pushes fill energy. Flick or slide into top-right for a clear one-bar snare-roll Fill. Kits stay code tables (no sample banks). Trap808 stays a separate specialised unit.

params.name: DENS
params.detail: Genre density: hats, ghosts, rims, or kick stutters

params.name: FILL
params.detail: Fill / break / build energy (top-right = one-bar snare roll)

params.name: GENRE
params.detail: Pattern: TRNC / DNB / BRK / UKG / BOOM / DEM / FOOT

params.name: KIT
params.detail: Voice feel: AUTO (follow GENRE) or TRNC / DNB / BRK / UKG / BOOM / DEM / FOOT
